name: คลินิกทันตแพทย์ธรณินทร์

summary_en: Thoranin Dental Clinic is located in Bangkok and specializes in general dental services. The clinic currently holds a rating of 4.2 based on 4 total reviews, with a documented trust score of 49.2.
